name: Home Assistant, Dashboard
description: Shows one of your existing Home Assistant dashboards as-is, no rebuilding in Tesserae. The server opens the dashboard in headless Chromium, signed in with the Home Assistant Core token, hides the sidebar and header, and captures the view at the cell's size. Point it at any dashboard path (lovelace/0, dashboard-kitchen/overview). Frames are re-rendered on the interval you set and the last good frame is kept between renders.

cell_options.name: path
cell_options.label: Dashboard path
cell_options.help: The part of the Home Assistant URL after the host, e.g. lovelace/0 or dashboard-kitchen/overview. Leave blank for the default dashboard.

cell_options.name: zoom
cell_options.label: Zoom
cell_options.help: Scales the dashboard before capture. Larger values make cards bigger and easier to read on e-ink, fewer of them fit.

cell_options.name: dark_mode
cell_options.label: Dark theme
cell_options.help: Render with Home Assistant's dark mode. Light is usually the better fit for a panel.

cell_options.name: kiosk
cell_options.label: Kiosk query
cell_options.help: Appends ?kiosk to the URL so the kiosk-mode integration, if installed, strips the remaining chrome. Harmless without it.

cell_options.name: settle_seconds
cell_options.label: Settle delay (seconds)
cell_options.help: Extra wait after the dashboard reports loaded, so cards that fetch their own data (history graphs, cameras, maps) have painted before capture.

cell_options.name: refresh_seconds
cell_options.label: Re-render interval (seconds)
cell_options.help: How old a captured frame may be before the next render replaces it. Each render opens a browser for a few seconds, so keep this near the panel's own wake interval.
